sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:111031
Court No. - 67
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 25285 of 2024

Applicant :- Tara Khatoon
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Juned Alam
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release her on bail in Case Crime No.50 of 2024, registered under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Chaurakhas, District Kushi Nagar during pendency of the trial.

entities.text: Police Station Chaurakhas, District Kushi Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
3. Allegation in the FIR is that informant's sister was married with the son of applicant, thereafter in-laws demanded for dowry of Rs.5 lacs and one bullet motorcycle and on non-fulfillment of dowry,
they committed murder to the informant's sister.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.
The cause of death of the deceased is due to asphyxia as a result of ante mortem hanging.
Allegation Tara Khatoon vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98557237/

entities.text: Allegation Tara Khatoon vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 in the FIR for demand of dowry against the applicant is false and baseless.
FIR was lodged after one day of the incident with ulterior motive.
Learned counsel for the applicant next submitted that co-accused Salaqat has been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 08.07.2024.
Applicant's case is identical to the co-accused, hence, the applicant is also entitled for bail on the ground of same footing.
Applicant has no previous criminal history.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 19.05.2024.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, she will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
4. Learned counsel for the informant has vehemently opposed the bail prayer of the applicant but could not disputed the facts as raised by applicant's counsel.

5. Considering the material available on record and keeping in view the nature of the offence,
argument advanced on behalf of the parties, evidence on record regarding complicity of the accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant, Tara Khatoon, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
ii. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
iii. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 9.7.2024 SKD  Tara Khatoon vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98557237/
